title: What Would You See If You Fell Into Jupiter?

input.text:
What Would You See If You Fell Into Jupiter?

What would you see if you fall into Jupiter? The colour is a cloud deck, not a surface. This film goes down through the bands, the 1995 Galileo probe, the last of the light, and a metal dark with no floor.

New film on YouTube. Link in bio.
